countingRule: sha256 is taken over CRLF-normalized (\r\n -> \n) UTF-8 content, because this repo is cloned on Windows with autocrlf and a raw-byte hash would report drift that does not exist in git. .gitattributes pins eol=lf so the checked-in form is LF everywhere.
